findings: v159: all four moves and exact owned UDP capture passed both signing variants; initial observer audio was wired to a nonexistent subscription port. Those quality failures remain retained, with this limitation explicit.

v160: no media tests ran; preflight refused scratch below five GiB. Older terminal fixtures v150-v154 were losslessly archived with every regular file SHA256 checked before expanded trees were removed.

342e943f/v161: corrected own-duplex-audio observation and faster polling of the original unchanged 30fps source coordinate. Zero source-coordinate skips in both actual runs. No catch-up frames, padding or timestamp offsets.

v161: both cohorts complete four moves and original teardown and validate actual duplex UDP capture, but all six quality routes fail. Audio duration and decoded AV skew remain outside profile; three ES256 routes also fail the stricter changing-frame-per-second check.

Matched marker medians are negative video-minus-audio: audio is observed roughly 81-117ms after Video. Do not assume Video is the delayed path or infer a WebRTC defect from this WT result. Trace source/capture, encoded submission and decoded reception separately before changing production buffering.

observer_profile.audio: actual mono960sample WebCodecs buffers; per20ms spectral identity and maximum uncovered gap after decoded20ms buffer; no synthesized/PLC coverage
observer_profile.video: actual640x360 decoded pixels, source identity and unique changing frames in every second (stricter than merely counting all decoded frames)
observer_profile.av: actual decoder-callback times, uniquely calibrated equal nonperiodic marker ordinals; envelope validity retained; no physical rendering claim

latest_source_clock_finding: v163 source audio advanced 61.095s over 62.007s wall time, while v161/v162 advanced 61.953s/62.023s. All three still fail decoded media. The source deficit varies and is not established as the sole cause. v163 sampled total CPU does not indicate exhaustion of all six VM cores. Keep actual source/output timing and limits unchanged; compare the next full workload before assigning causation.
